title: Lower integrals over G(M) split along a Borel partition of M up to a null image (G continuous and injective on M)
statement: Let m, d, P ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^d, A_i ⊆ ℝ^d (i ∈ ℕ) and G : ℝ^d → ℝ^P. Assume G is continuous on M and injective on M, every A_i is Borel with A_i ⊆ M, the A_i are pairwise disjoint, and H^m(G(M ∖ ⋃_i A_i)) = 0, where H^m := μHE[m]. Then for every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] (no measurability required), ∫⁻_{G(M)} g dH^m = Σ_{i∈ℕ} ∫⁻_{G(A_i)} g dH^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid d)) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P), ContinuousOn G M → InjOn G M → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → (∀ i, A i ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[m] (G '' (M \ ⋃ i, A i)) = 0 → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' M, g w ∂μHE[m] = ∑' i, ∫⁻ w in G '' A i, g w ∂μHE[m]
